decisions.reason: An accelerator program for green startups sits outside the firm's core machinery business and uses scarce management resources, so a young, cash-constrained firm is likely to cut it.

The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder is a differentiated sustainability product with its own page, but its distance from plant engineering and the long approval cycles in road construction make it vulnerable.
The infectious waste decontamination plant was launched with partner ERMAFA and targets a regulated niche with steady demand, so it is worth continuing.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is the newest core WASTX machine and works both on its own and as a pretreatment stage, so it is central to the firm's strategy.
